summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli arrives at Las Vegas with a commanding 111-point lead over Max Verstappen, but a qualifying penalty hands pole position to Verstappen despite Antonelli's fastest time, setting up a tense battle between the championship leader and his closest rival. George Russell and Verstappen reignite their rivalry on the front row, with tension already boiling over between the Mercedes and Red Bull drivers heading into the weekend. Antonelli can move within one win of clinching the drivers' championship, with only Qatar and Abu Dhabi remaining after Las Vegas.
